composition_strategy: Symmetrical floral arrangement with balanced mass distribution, creating a harmonious and elegant environment for a bridal celebration.
focal_strategy: The focal point is a large, centrally placed floral wreath that draws attention while maintaining the overall symmetry of the composition.
depth_strategy: Depth is created through the use of layered floral patterns, with a gradient from lighter and more delicate patterns at the center to darker and more intricate patterns towards the edges, simulating a sense of depth and movement.
border_or_perimeter_strategy: The perimeter is treated with a soft, delicate floral pattern that frames the composition, enhancing the elegant and celebratory atmosphere.
title_safe_region_strategy: The title safe region is positioned at the top center of the composition, leaving ample space for the text without obstructing the floral patterns.
programme_safe_region_strategy: The programme safe region is placed at the bottom center, ensuring that any additional text or information can be added without interfering with the main visual elements.
